A DIFC-licensed institution establishing what it was actually running on personal data, and what it could evidence about each system.

The engagement

Three parts, in order.

01

The situation

What the organisation already had, and what it could not answer. This is where the review starts and it is usually the part the client finds most uncomfortable to read back.

02

What we did

The scope, the method, and the parts we deliberately did not touch. Duration and the deliverable at the end.

03

What changed

What the organisation can now evidence that it could not before, and what remains open. Including anything the review recommended that was not done.
